about: Trainspotter sound effects: ElevenLabs sound effects generated through asset-bot (fal.ai). Two takes of each, shipped as variants _01 and _02. loop: true sounds are trimmed to their steady body and made seamless. cut: sounds are not generated; they are single hits cut from another sound's takes.
suffix: , clean close recording, no music, no voices, no speech

sounds.about: single exhaust beats cut from the slow chuffing takes; play one per beat, four per turn of the driving wheels
a short showcase layered from the takes: slow chuffing that swells in as the engine nears, with a long whistle; the pack's first file, so the catalogue plays it as the preview
